title: Technician Utilization: the Est. Lost Labor info icon works as before
custom_preconds:

custom_steps:

  3. Point at the info icon beside "Est. Lost Labor".
  4. Move the pointer away.
  5. Click the info icon.
  6. Click the info icon again.
